characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Brood Rivalry and Minimised (Break Tests, Fear Tests, Panic Tests)

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100~SI.The model gains Maximised (Stomp Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

The model gains Weapon Master and Light Armour.
At the start of each Round of Combat that the model is fighting, if the model is within 12" of one or more other friendly models that are equipped with Great Weapon, Paired Weapons, and/or Shield, the model gains the corresponding equipment until the end of the Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Fly (6", 12"), Hard Target (1), Light Troops, Skirmisher, and
Extra Support (2).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Catapult (4×4), Range 12--60", Shots 1, Str 3 [7], AP 0 [4], [Multiple Wounds (D3, Clipped Wings)].

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Catapult, Range 12--48", Shots 1.
This weapon follows the rules for Catapult Artillery Weapons with the following exceptions:
  • Hit: The target suffers 2D6 hits with Strength 4 and Armour Penetration 2.
  • Partial Hit: Place a Mad Git following the rules for Summoned Units within 3" of the target, with as little of its base as possible inside the target's Front Arc.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Range 48", Shots 1, Str 3 [6], AP 10, [Multiple Wounds (D3)], Area Attack (1×5). The model's base is changed to 60~SI round.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

After determining Deployment Zones (at the end of step 6 of the Pre-Game Sequence), you may choose Fields, Forests, Ruins, or Water Terrain. All models (friend and foe) treat Terrain Features of the chosen Terrain as Dangerous Terrain (1). Models that would normally treat them as Dangerous Terrain (1) treat the Terrain Features of the chosen Terrain as Dangerous Terrain (2) instead. In addition, friendly models with Goblin Cunning gain Strider (X), where X is the chosen Terrain.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Feigned Flight, Light Troops, and Vanguard and loses Scoring.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Immediately before choosing a unit to join using the Hidden rule, the model may gain a Beastie mount without any upgrade for free. If the model joins a unit with at least one R&F model with Creepy-Crawlies, the model's mount gains Creepy-Crawlies.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Model parts without Harnessed gain March and Shoot, Poison Attacks, and Throwing Weapons~(4+) with Shots 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Model parts without Harnessed gains Battle Focus, Hatred, and Great Weapon.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

For each Netter in base contact, enemy units suffer -1 Agility and -1 Armour Penetration, up to -2 each.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Hard Target(1), Light Troops, Scout, Skirmisher, and Strider and loses Scoring.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Natural to-wound rolls of '1' with Melee Attacks from friendly units within 6" must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model can cast Guile and Fury (Hereditary Spell) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8). When attempting to cast the Bound Spell, the owner can choose which version to cast.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's base size is changed to 100×150~SI, and it gains +2 Health Points and 4 additional Goblin model parts.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model must be deployed using Special Deployment rules. At the start of any Player Turn, the owner may choose a friendly non-Fleeing unengaged unit of Goblin Rabble or Gogtuk Neophytes. Deploy the model with Mad Git within 3" of the chosen unit and more than 1" away from Impassable Terrain and other units. If the model is not deployed by the end of Game Turn 4, it counts as a casualty and cannot be deployed for the rest of the game.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Creepy-Crawlies, and its base size is changed to 50×50~SI.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute -- Close Combat

For each Fortitude Save the model fails against enemy Melee Attacks, choose a model from the model's Health Pool. The chosen model must perform a Close Combat Attack at the same Initiative Step if able to, before any casualties are removed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Wyvern gains Stomp Attacks (D3) and Towering Presence, its Health Points are set to 5, and its base size is changed to 75×100~SI.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

  •
  •

When declaring a Charge, the model may choose to gain Impact Hits (1) with Area Attack (4×4). If so, the model’s Defensive Skill is set to 1, it cannot perform any other Special Attacks nor Close Combat Attacks, and it becomes Shaken. The effects last until the end of the Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the General is a Tribe Leader, apply the following changes to Army List creation:


  • Max. 10% of the Army Points may be spent on units with Goblin Cunning.

  • The Duplication Limits 0--X Units/Army, 0--X Models/Army, and in the unit profiles of certain units with Brood Rivalry are modified, as indicated by TL~0--X. For example, 0--1 Units/Army means that if the General is a Tribe Leader, the Duplication Limit becomes 0--2 Units/Army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If the General is a Darrmu, apply the following changes to Army List creation:


  • Max. 10% of the Army Points may be spent on units with Brood Rivalry.

  • The Duplication Limits 0--X Units/Army, 0--X Models/Army, and in the unit profiles of certain units with Goblin Cunning are modified, as indicated by D~0--X. For example, 0--1 Units/Army means that if the General is a Darrmu, the Duplication Limit becomes 0--2 Units/Army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units with Brood Alpha must buy a Champion upgrade if available. Champions with Brood Alpha gain +1 Health Point up to a maximum of 4 and +1 Attack Value, their Discipline is set to 7, and they gain a Great Weapon. In case of Multipart Models, the Attack Value modifier only affects a single model part without Harnessed or Inanimate. Champions with Brood Alpha can choose different Close Combat Weapons than other R&F models in their unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Model parts without Harnessed gain +1 Attack Value while both the following conditions are met:


  • The model's unit contains one or more R&F models.

  • A model from another friendly unit is Engaged in Combat anywhere on the Battlefield.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Apply the following rules to any unit consisting entirely of models with Goblin Cunning:


  • It gains Maximised (Flee Distance).

  • Before rolling any dice for the corresponding test, it may choose to fail any Break Test and, unless more than half its models are Fearless, any Panic Test.

  • If it Flees due to a voluntary Flee Charge Reaction or due to choosing to fail a Panic or Break Test, it automatically passes its next Rally Test. This does not apply if the unit is Decimated or if it Flees involuntarily.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly models without Beloved Mascots gain Hatred against enemy units in base contact with one or more friendly models with Beloved Mascots.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Ghost Step, and model parts with Harnessed gain Poison Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One of a Kind.
The model gains Bodyguard (General). In addition, a Standard Bearer with Headbashers gains Battle Standard Bearer and can take up to 2 Banner Enchantments with a Special Item allowance with no limit. If the model's unit would normally count towards Core, it counts towards Special instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Each unit can only be chosen up to 3 times per Player Turn for the deployment of models with Unprofessional Courtesy.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model cannot benefit from Parry. After the First Round of Combat until the model is no longer Engaged in Combat all its weapons count as Hand Weapons for all rules purposes.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model cannot declare any Charges, and other units cannot declare any Charges against the model. The model and other units ignore each other regarding the Unit Spacing rule for all movement and can touch and move through one another during any movement (note that this includes Ambush). When the model touches another unit, the model is immediately removed as a casualty, and the other unit immediately suffers X hits with the model's Strength and Armour Penetration. If several units are touched simultaneously, the Active Player chooses which unit suffers the hits. If the model was removed due to another unit moving into contact with it, that unit suffers an additional D6 hits.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--70 Models/Army.
Spear. Attacks made with a Poisoned Spear become Poison Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only. May be activated at the start of any friendly Player Turn, provided the General is on the Battlefield and not Fleeing. Apply the following effects until the start of the next friendly Player Turn:

  • Friendly units gain +1" Advance Rate and +2" March Rate.

  • If the General is a Goblin Demagogue or a Goblin Witch, friendly units consisting entirely of models with Goblin Cunning, while not Engaged in Combat, gain Light Troops and lose Scoring.

  • If the General is an Orc Warlord or an Orc Shaman, friendly units consisting entirely of models with Brood Rivalry gain Maximised (Charge Range).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using this weapon, the wielder gains +1 Attack Value, Strength, and Armour Penetration for each friendly unit that contains one or more models with Brood Rivalry Engaged in Combat anywhere on the Battlefield, up to maximum of +3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When performing Close Combat Attacks other than Crush Attacks, the wielder must perform 3 additional Close Combat Attacks in the same Initiative Step whose Strength is always set to 5 and whose Armour Penetration is always set to 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's model gains +1 Health Point and its Resilience is set to 6.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The bearer gains Rally Around the Flag (3", max. 3"). If the bearer has another instance of Rally Around the Flag,
it gains Rally Around the Flag (+3", max. 18") instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Roll a D3 right before the battle (during step 7 of the Deployment Phase Sequence) . R&F model parts without Harnessed in the bearer's unit gain one of the following effects until the end of the game depending on the result of the roll:
  • +1 Strength
  • Lethal Strike
  • Lightning Reflexes

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated at the start of any Player Turn. Until the end of the Player Turn, the bearer’s unit gains Fearless and Unstable.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Add one Veil Token to your Veil Token pool whenever:


  • A friendly unit with at least one model with Goblin Cunning passes a Rally Test.

  • A friendly unit with at least one model with Brood Rivalry successfully completes a Charge.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer can cast Totemic Summon (Shamanism) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When successfully wounded, the bearer may choose to use the attacker's Armour value and/or its Special Save:
  • Use the Armour value that the attacking model would have against the attack that inflicted the wound (including Conditional Application, modifiers, etc.). If so, the bearer cannot use its own Armour (including any modifiers), if available.
  • Use the Special Save that the attacking model would have against the attack that inflicted the wound (including Conditional Application, modifiers, etc.). If so, the bearer cannot use its own Special Save (including any modifiers), if available.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated at the start of any Player Turn. Until the end of the Player Turn, friendly Gnashers units within 18" gain Maximised (Charge Range), Battle Focus, and Frenzy.
